The main takeaway from our work is that
HIF1-alpha is an important regulator of endocrine differentiation in the pancreas and that this process is dependent on vascularisation.
the HIF pathway is a key regulator of beta cell differentiation and that the Vhl gene is a potential target in the development of novel therapeutic strategies.
